svg.text: Two ports on the UAE east coast, and straight answers to the questions
Khorfakkan and Fujairah sit on the same coast, on
the Gulf of Oman, and the same team covers both.

What we do at each port
Not here? Ask us on WhatsApp and we will reply
How quickly can you deliver fresh water?
It depends on where the ship is and how much water is needed. Send us the
vessel, position and quantity on WhatsApp and we will give you a time
What do you need from us to book?
Vessel name and IMO, where the ship is, what you need and when. For water
add the quantity, for crew boats add the number of people and any cargo.
Do you deliver water to ships at anchor?
Yes. Malik takes water out to ships at anchor at Khorfakkan and Fujairah.
Can you deliver to ships alongside?
Ask us on WhatsApp for your berth and we will confirm.
No. We own one vessel, the water barge Malik. For crew boats we act as your
agent and book the right boat for the job.
Can you arrange a crew change?
Yes. We arrange the boat out to the ship and can help with the rest of the crew
Monday to Friday 9:00 to 17:00, Saturday 9:00 to 13:00, closed Sunday.
We agree payment terms with you before the job.
